P-DOM-01.summary: A smarter, safer home: devices split onto separate networks, with media kept at home instead of locked in someone's cloud.

sections.heading: What we set up
items: Separate networks for work, kids and smart-home devices, so one weak gadget can't reach the rest
A private media server on the home's own storage
Hardening of the router and every device
